title: 澳洲留學資訊分享會--雪梨科技大學雙聯學位推廣Study Abroad Information Session - Welcome to University of Technology Sydney. Shaping your future

對象： 全校學生
標題： 澳洲留學資訊分享會--雪梨科技大學雙聯學位推廣Study Abroad Information Session - Welcome to University of Technology Sydney. Shaping your future
日期： Mon, 24 Feb 2025 18:02:03 +0800

雪梨科技大學位於澳洲最大城市雪梨的市中心，是一所世界頂尖的科技大學，長年名列全球最佳年輕大學之一。學校在商學、工程、資訊科技、設計與傳播等領域皆享有極高的國際聲譽，畢業生深受全球雇主青睞。

國際處特別邀請雪梨科技大學 Ms. Leona 來為大家介紹雪梨科技大學2+2雙聯學位，說明申請方式、學習環境及未來發展機會。這場說明會將幫助有意前往澳洲留學的同學了解申請流程，並為未來的學術與職業生涯做好準備。

日期：02月26日
時間：13:00 PM - 14:00 PM
地點：行政大樓 301室
活動報名時間：即日起至02/25 中午12點
報名連結：https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=24307

Join us for an exciting info session with Ms. Leona from the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) as she introduces the UTS Dual Degree Program 2+2. Learn about the application process, study environment, and career opportunities available through this program. If you're considering studying in Australia, this session is the perfect opportunity to gain insights and prepare for your future academic journey!

About UTS:
Located in the heart of Sydney, UTS is a world-class university renowned for its strong industry connections, innovative teaching methods, and practical learning approach. Consistently ranked among the top young universities globally, UTS excels in business, engineering, information technology, design, and communication. Its strong ties with industry partners provide students with excellent internship and career development opportunities.

Date: February 26th
Time: 13:00 PM - 14:00 PM
Location: Administration Building, Room 301
Registration for the event is open from now until 12:00 PM on February 25th.
